# Results — Study 640 (Gold-Overnight, "Gold Trades in Its Sleep")

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test — **for two
decades gold rose overnight (close → open) and went nowhere during London/NY hours (open →
close)**, an anomaly the literature parks around the London gold fixes (Caminschi & Heaney
2014; the Adrian Douglas "buy the PM fix, sell the AM fix" folklore) — tested on **GLD**
(the claim's home instrument), confirmed on **IAU** (a second sponsor tracking the same
metal), and judged against the **SPY equity placebo** (study
[01-overnight-anomaly](../01-overnight-anomaly/) showed US equities carry their own
overnight effect, so gold's must beat that bar, not a vacuum). Offline & deterministic once
cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every number. As-of **2026-06-30** (the
last complete month; later sessions are sliced off). Fingerprint `648ab68f37f2`.*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily **adjusted open + close** (total-return, split-adjusted) for GLD, IAU, SPY — public, no key |
| Window | 2004-11-19 → 2026-06-30 (**5,435** GLD sessions, **21.6 years**; IAU from 2005-01-31, 5,387 sessions) |
| Split | **overnight** = prior close → today's open (US exchange shut; Asia + London AM fix) · **intraday** = open → close (London PM fix + NY hours). The two legs compound exactly to close-to-close |
| Adjustment | `auto_adjust=True` on **both** open and close (GLD/IAU pay no dividend; IAU's 2021 reverse split adjusted on both legs; SPY dividends sit in the adjusted close, which flatters the equity placebo's overnight leg — conservative for the comparison) |
| Execution / costs | the overlay rule is unconditional and clock-based: **buy the official close (MOC), sell the next open (MOO)** — the MOC/MOO convention *is* the documented one-bar lag (nothing is conditioned on same-bar information); costs **2 one-way trades/day × {0.5, 1, 2, 5} bps × NAV**; long-only (no borrow) |
| Survivorship | none in the panel sense: GLD, IAU, SPY are single, continuously-listed funds spanning the whole window — no basket selection, no delisted names to omit |

## The signal — gold really does trade in its sleep

Session split, in bps/day; HAC = Newey-West *t* on the daily mean; the **primary statistic
is the HAC *t* on the paired daily difference** (overnight − intraday); the sign-flip *p* is
a 20,000-draw seeded permutation of the night/day labels within each session.

| tape | overnight (HAC *t*) | intraday (HAC *t*) | **gap** (HAC *t*) | Welch *t* | sign-flip *p* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **GLD** | **+4.30 bps/d** (*t* = +4.05) | +0.22 bps/d (*t* = +0.22) | **+4.08 bps/d** (*t* = **+2.94**) | +2.69 | **0.0030** |
| **IAU** (confirm) | +5.03 bps/d (*t* = +4.63) | −0.35 bps/d (*t* = −0.36) | **+5.39 bps/d** (*t* = **+3.83**) | +3.51 | **0.0002** |
| SPY (placebo) | +3.37 bps/d (*t* = +3.94) | +1.43 bps/d (*t* = +1.29) | +1.94 bps/d (*t* = +1.38) | +1.23 | 0.1071 |

The cumulative decomposition is the folklore chart, and it is real: over 21.6 years a
**$1 sleeve holding GLD only overnight grew 8.63×** (+10.51%/yr) while the **intraday-only
sleeve went nowhere: 0.96×** (−0.18%/yr) — essentially the *entire* close-to-close gain
(+10.31%/yr) accrued while US exchanges were shut. IAU is starker: **12.51× overnight vs
0.71× intraday**. Both gold tapes clear the desk bar on the gap (HAC *t* = 2.94 and 3.83);
the sign-flip placebo puts a random night/day labeling at *p* ≈ 0.003 / 0.0002. **Signal:
REAL.**

Two honest nuances, said out loud:

- **Gold's gap is ~2× SPY's but not *significantly* bigger.** On the identical 5,435-day
  calendar gold's gap is +4.08 bps/d vs SPY's +1.94 bps/d; the Welch *t* on the difference
  between the two daily-difference series is only **+1.00**. Gold clears the *t* ≥ 2 bar on
  its own tape (SPY here does not), but the tape cannot certify that gold's clock effect is
  a *different animal* from the market-wide one of study 01 — both gaps are noisy daily series.
- **The pre-reform sub-sample alone is not significant on GLD** (below) — the full-window
  *t* and the IAU confirmation carry the stamp.

## Sub-period split — the 2015 fix reform did NOT kill it

The London Gold Fix (phone call among five bullion banks, est. 1919) was replaced by the
electronic LBMA Gold Price auction on **2015-03-20** — an externally-dated break, chosen
because the fix mechanism *is* the claim's alleged engine (fix manipulation was fined in
2014). If the anomaly were fix-rigging leakage, it should shrink after the reform.

| tape | period | overnight | intraday | gap (HAC *t*) |
|---|---|--:|--:|--:|
| GLD | pre-reform 2004-11-19 → 2015-03-19 (n = 2,599) | +3.71 bps/d | +0.64 bps/d | +3.07 bps/d (*t* = +1.35) |
| GLD | post-reform 2015-03-20 → 2026-06-30 (n = 2,836) | +4.84 bps/d | −0.17 bps/d | **+5.01 bps/d** (*t* = **+2.98**) |
| IAU | pre-reform (n = 2,551) | +4.77 bps/d | −0.15 bps/d | +4.92 bps/d (*t* = +2.11) |
| IAU | post-reform (n = 2,836) | +5.27 bps/d | −0.53 bps/d | **+5.81 bps/d** (*t* = **+3.46**) |

Change-in-gap Welch *t* = **−0.65** (GLD) and **−0.29** (IAU) — negative means the gap
*grew* after the reform; neither change is significant. **No decay**: the anomaly is as
strong under the audited electronic auction as under the old phone fix, which argues
*against* the fix-manipulation mechanism and *for* a structural clock/venue effect (gold's
price discovery happens in Asia and London while NYSE Arca is shut, so the listed ETF can
only mark it at the open).

## Harvest test (third axis) — was it ever tradable net of daily spreads?

Long-only overnight overlay on GLD: buy MOC, sell next MOO, flat all day — **2 one-way
trades every day**. Net = gross overnight leg − 2 × cost. Buy & hold is the same tape held
through (its one-off entry cost rounds to zero over two decades).

| one-way cost | net (bps/d) | net annualised | buy & hold | HAC *t* (net) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 0.5 bps | +3.30 | **+7.76%** | +10.31% | +3.11 |
| 1 bps | +2.30 | **+5.08%** | +10.31% | +2.17 |
| 2 bps | +0.30 | **−0.08%** | +10.31% | +0.28 |
| 5 bps | −5.70 | **−14.11%** | +10.31% | −5.37 |

Sub-periods tell the same story: pre-reform the overlay nets +6.05% / +3.41% / −1.67% /
−15.47% vs +9.42% buy & hold at 0.5/1/2/5 bps; post-reform +9.35% / +6.63% / +1.39% /
−12.84% vs +11.13%. **At every cost level, in every sub-period, the overlay trails simply
holding gold.** The arithmetic is unforgiving: dodging the intraday leg buys you a
statistical **zero** (GLD intraday = +0.22 bps/d, *t* = 0.22 — on GLD you would be dodging
a *positive*; on IAU −0.35 bps/d, so break-even one-way cost ≤ ~0.18 bps), while paying two
spreads a day costs a hard 1–10 bps. GLD's penny spread was ~2 bps of price in 2005 and
~0.3 bps today — never below the break-even. The short-day / long-night version adds two
more legs plus borrow and dies faster. **It was never harvestable — the anomaly describes
*when* gold's return arrives, not a trade.** Third axis: **BUSTED**.

## Synthetic control — the machinery is faithful *(never cited for the stamp)*

Deterministic seeded world (`synthetic_world`, ~20-year business-day index) with a tunable
planted overnight drift; the null (no edge) must stay quiet, the planted world must light up.

| planted night edge | gap (bps/d) | HAC *t* | Welch *t* | sign-flip *p* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 0 bps/d (null) | +0.73 | +0.47 | +0.48 | 0.314 |
| +4 bps/d (≈ the real GLD gap) | +4.73 | **+3.06** | +3.12 | 0.000 |

The split does not manufacture a gap from noise and recovers a planted one of exactly the
real tape's size — a machinery proof only.

## Verdict

- **Signal — REAL.** GLD's overnight-minus-intraday gap is **+4.08 bps/day** at HAC
  ***t* = 2.94** (sign-flip *p* = 0.003), confirmed on IAU at **+5.39 bps/day, HAC
  *t* = 3.83** (*p* = 0.0002); the overnight leg alone carries the entire 21.6-year gain
  (8.63× vs 0.96×). Clears **t ≥ 2 on the real tape** on both gold funds. Caveats stated:
  gold's gap is ~2× SPY's but not significantly bigger (Welch *t* = 1.00 vs the equity
  placebo), and the GLD pre-2015 sub-sample alone sits at *t* = 1.35.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** Even **frictionless**, the overnight-only sleeve earns
  +10.51%/yr vs +10.31%/yr for just holding GLD — there is nothing to dodge (intraday
  *t* = 0.22). With 2 trades/day, the overlay trails buy & hold at **every** cost level in
  **every** sub-period (+7.76% at an unrealistically tight 0.5 bps; −0.08% at 2 bps). The
  anomaly is a *description of when the return arrives*, not an edge over holding.
- **"Ever harvestable net of spreads?" — BUSTED.** Break-even one-way cost is at most
  ~0.18 bps (IAU) and *negative* on GLD — below any spread GLD has ever traded at. Bonus
  myth-check: the **2015 LBMA fix reform did not dent it** (gap +3.07 → +5.01 bps/d, change
  Welch *t* = −0.65) — the "fix-manipulation leak" mechanism fails; the boring
  clock-and-venue explanation stands.
